Chapter 955 Chapter 16: The Ultimate Attack (Please Subscribe)

Chapter 955  Chapter 16: The Ultimate Attack (Please Subscribe)

"Know a little of everything?"

Hearing the Ancestor of Martial Arts speak these words with an incomparably calm tone, Zhang Tianzhi fell into a bit of silence.

Even the strongest evolutionary pathways have focal points, and the supreme beings do too. Is it possible that the Ancestor of Martial Arts knows a little of everything?

Although they say 'a little', Zhang Tianzhi didn't dare to truly believe it was just 'a little'.

Doesn't this mean that, in some aspects, the Ancestor of Martial Arts could be even stronger than the nine supreme beings of human civilization?

If it were any other evolutionary, no matter how outdated the information, Zhang Tianzhi would think it a joke.

Stronger than a supreme being? The nine supreme beings of human civilization not only stand at the pinnacle of human civilization but also at the summit of the Starry Sky Races.

Stronger than a supreme being, isn't that nonsense?

But the Ancestor of Martial Arts?

Zhang Tianzhi vaguely felt that the Ancestor of Martial Arts wasn't lying.

The Martial Arts Evolutionary pathway hasn't even advanced to the twelfth layer as the strongest evolutionary path, yet it ranks fifth in human civilization, which already explains a lot.

...

Next.

Lin Yuan casually answered several of Zhang Tianzhi's doubts and then ended the 'call' with him.

Lin Yuan personally met with Zhang Tianzhi, solely because the latter was the first to step into the Eighth Layer of the Martial Arts Evolutionary pathway.

It was entirely out of pity for future evolutionaries.

...

On the Barbaric Wilderness Planet.

Zhang Tianzhi disconnected from the Virtual World, looking lost and forlorn.

After just a short exchange with the Ancestor of Martial Arts, Zhang Tianzhi felt his understanding of Martial Tao and of many other evolutionary paths had drastically changed.

This change was like viewing from the highest vantage point; Zhang Tianzhi's understanding of the essence of evolution had greatly improved.

"This is the Ancestor of Martial Arts..." Zhang Tianzhi steadied his spirit, and in his heart, he actually wanted to add something else.

That is—

Even supreme beings are merely so-so, right?

"I heard that the true identity of the Ancestor of Martial Arts is the Galaxy Master..." Zhang Tianzhi thought of some rumors recently circulating within human civilization.

The theory that the Galaxy Master is the founder of Martial Tao has been spreading widely.

The official stance of human civilization has not stopped this, nor has the Ancestor of Martial Arts come forward to dispel the rumors.

This leads to the rumor's credibility growing ever higher.

With the status of the Ancestor of Martial Arts in human civilization, if there were any false rumors, the human civilization officials would surely come forward to contain it.

But they did not.

Although human civilization officials have also not appeared to confirm it.

But sometimes, silence equals consent; the same goes for the Ancestor of Martial Arts.

"Galaxy Master..." Zhang Tianzhi swallowed hard, realizing that the entire growth trajectory of the Galaxy Master, from birth to the present, could be clearly traced.

Such an evolutionary genius who is not even a thousand years old, how could he be related to the founder of the Martial Arts Evolutionary path? Yet they turned out to be the same person.

"Martial Tao Eighth Layer..."

Zhang Tianzhi's mind kept flashing back to everything the Ancestor of Martial Arts had said just now.

At this moment, Zhang Tianzhi saw a clear path from the Eighth Layer to the Ninth Stage Martial Tao.

It was due to both the Ancestor of Martial Arts' guidance from a loftier place and Zhang Tianzhi's own accumulation over thousands of years, which burst forth under the mentoring of the Ancestor of Martial Arts today.

"I will commence closed-door cultivation now."

Zhang Tianzhi immediately closed his eyes, planning to continue his retreat right there for hundreds or thousands of years to fully absorb the guidance of the Ancestor of Martial Arts.

...

In front of the naturally formed space-time black hole.

The Taiyang Divine Spirit of Lin Yuan was sitting cross-legged.

Black holes are special cosmic bodies within the universe, and space-time black holes are created by numerous black hole collisions leading to the collapse of space-time, forming a massive celestial phenomenon.

Even for a Level Eleven Perfect being, in the presence of a massive space-time black hole, they appear extremely insignificant and might be pulled in if careless.

Many Ancient Gods at Level Eleven Perfect have established various space-time black hole Secret Techniques based on naturally occurring space-time black holes in the universe.

The strongest among them only possesses a mere one millionth or one ten-millionth of the real space-time black hole's power.

"Space-time black hole?" Lin Yuan observed the space-time black hole in front of him carefully; time and space are inherently one but can also repel each other.

Space-time black holes are an example, with time and space clashing to the extreme, resulting in the formation of space-time black holes; the emanating shockwaves are close to the twelfth level.

"If I can thoroughly understand the space-time black hole before me and grasp the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule, even if I can't reach the peak of the Seventh Realm, the difference won't be too great," Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Merely the unconscious and unguided collision of time and space could burst forth with near twelfth-level power; once controlled by humans, the effects produced would be unimaginable.

"It's time to leave."

After a long while, Lin Yuan gradually ceased his perception.

At this point, with each aspect of his true self at its pinnacle and the Ultimate level imminent, there would be no issue in coming back to comprehend the space-time black hole after stepping into the twelfth layer.

...

In a dark and somber hall.

The time of Nine-day Worship has passed in the blink of an eye.

More than a dozen Ultimate beings of the twelfth layer have arrived once again.

"Nine days have gone by."

"Lord Fan, have you locked onto the position of the Galaxy Master?"

"Yes, have you located him? Time is of the essence; the Galaxy Master can attempt to reach the Ultimate level at any moment."

The tones of the various twelfth-layer Ultimate beings were quite urgent.

Once the Galaxy Masters decide to make the ultimate leap, they will no longer have the chance to intervene.

As Galaxy Masters challenge the ultimate, the nine mightiest human beings will inevitably set up numerous spatial-temporal mazes. At that time, they won't have any idea where the Galaxy Masters are attempting the ultimate leap within a short period.

Once the time has passed and the Galaxy Master leaps to the ultimate, all they can do is watch helplessly.

With the ultimate leap at Level Eleven Perfect, everything will leap out of the river of time, and during the process, it will suffer from the backlash of both the river of time and the Main Universe.

Similarly, this backlash also serves as protection, ensuring that aside from the backlash, no other external forces can interfere with the ultimate leap.

Although the entities at the twelfth level have completely freed themselves from the shackles of the river of time, this freedom does not imply that they can oppose the river of time.

"It's almost time."

Ultimate Lord Fan from the Prison Tribe frowned deeply, his true self in the depths of the Prison Tribe's territory having already worshipped the phantom of the Galaxy Master for a full nine days.

With every kneel during these nine days, the causality between himself and the Galaxy Master deepened significantly. Now, after nine days of worship, the causality between Lord Fan and the Galaxy Master far exceeds that between the closest kin.

Of course, this causal connection, formed through nine-day worship, can only last for a short time, and the price Lord Fan paid for it is horrific, taking millions to billions of years to recover from.

"To think that I, a grand twelfth-layer being, would pay such a price just to lock down your location, you should be proud," thought Ultimate Lord Fan from the Prison Tribe as he took a deep breath.

The price he paid far exceeds that of battling other entities at the twelfth level.

If it weren't for the promise from the peak clans such as the Prison Tribe that they would not attack the Prison Tribe in the long years to come, on top of the threat posed by the Galaxy Master, he would not have done this.

...

The gloomy great hall.

Ultimate Lord Fan from the Prison Tribe looked towards the other entities at the twelfth level.

"It's done."

Continental Lord Fan from the Prison Tribe spoke.

"Good, good, good."

"Hahahaha, Galaxy Master, what use is your causal treasure for protection?"

Smiles appeared on the faces of the entities at the twelfth level.

"How many avatars does the Galaxy Master have outside?"

The Ultimate of the Prison Tribe immediately asked.

"Currently, the number of avatars the Galaxy Master has distributed within the universe totals to one hundred and forty-three..." Ultimate Lord Fan from the Prison Tribe closed his eyes, sensing carefully.

At this moment, his connection of causality with Lin Yuan was at its strongest. Even with multiple layers of separation, he could lock onto Lin Yuan's position.

"One hundred and forty-three avatars..."

The Ultimate from the Prison Tribe exchanged glances with the other entities at the twelfth level. The Galaxy Master had released so many avatars outside, and even after a century of locking on, they haven't located even one?

In the end, it took Lord Fan, who paid a tremendous price and employed the 'Nine-day Worship' secret technique, just to barely lock on?

"Hm?"

"I can sense one of the Galaxy Master's avatars is outside the universe?"

Ultimate Lord Fan from the Prison Tribe's expression shifted slightly as he spoke involuntarily.

Outside the universe? That is a domain even the beings of the twelfth level cannot explore.

"Outside the universe? Where?"

The Ultimate of the Prison Tribe immediately asked.

"Unclear."

"Even with the enhancement of the 'Nine-day Worship' secret technique, the presence of the universe makes it impossible to sense specifics."

Ultimate Lord Fan from the Prison Tribe shook his head.

The universe itself is capable of severing layers of causality and space-time.

With the Chaos Void outside the universe having even more abundant and countless rules than within, trying to sense the causality outside the universe with that from within is even more difficult than ascending to the heavens.

Thus, Lord Fan could not detect too much.

"Wanhua once said that the Galaxy Master's mental will has reached the twelfth level, and with his mental will, it's estimated that he has formed an avatar nearby the universe..." conjectured the Ultimate of the Prison Tribe.

Beings of the twelfth level can also form avatars outside the universe, but the avatars have only a short connection with their true selves, and they are constantly eroded by Chaos Qi.

Therefore, after a few trials, the twelfth level beings generally lost interest.

"All right, pick one of the avatars with the deepest causal connection, lock down the spatial coordinates, and then we will directly descend there."

The Ultimate of the Prison Tribe stated.

While any avatar of the Galaxy Master would suffice, obviously the one with the deepest connection to the Galaxy Master would be best.

"It's right here..."

"In front of Spatial-Temporal Black Hole No. 52."

Ultimate Lord Fan from the Prison Tribe announced a specific coordinate.

"I'll take you there." The ancestor of the Tianyu Clan waved their hands, and an invisible wave of space-time swept over, instantly making the many beings of the twelfth level vanish from the scene.

...

Lin Yuan stood in front of the spatial-temporal black hole, having stood up and planning to leave, to reunite with his true self and challenge the ultimate.

But at that moment.

Whoosh.

The flow of space-time moved like water.

One majestic figure after another arrived in an instant, encircling Lin Yuan with more than a dozen imposing figures, isolating space-time, turning Lin Yuan's piece of the universe into a 'lonely island'.

"Galaxy Master, savor the source of chaos and corruption to your heart's content."

The Ultimate of the Tianyu Clan took the lead, twenty-four pairs of wings covering the cosmos, as a pristine right hand reached out, attempting to oppress Lin Yuan.

A terrifying aura pervaded, and an endless force began to influence layers upon layers of space-time.

"Huh?"

Lin Yuan looked slightly startled.
